question: Will U.S. real GDP growth, quarter on quarter at an annual rate (BEA, chained dollars, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for Q3 2025 (the latest quarterly reading dated on or before 2025-08-14) be above 0.14%, its value for Q1 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-07-15 (Q1 2025), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
